limits: Shared hints do not reserve messages or establish resolver retirement. Terminal state can precede mechanical Promise release; zero live quota duties are checked after a subsequent owning IO-worker turn. Physical close wakes pending hints before unpinning Engine.
Readability Futures have a shared cooperative token ignored by this producer. Use a private token with Core cancelable wait or detach one Watch.

RegistryBytes includes the optional24-byte mode header growth, not separate Core signal allocations. Current signal plus one constructor and the bounded worker resolver tail have finite internal ownership; retained old terminal epochs are caller-owned.

Size/functional/interop results do not establish production readiness. All four products remain developing; desired-subscription state, reconnect/replay, Sentinel/Cluster and other product scope remain.

The streaming workload is bounded application bursts, not fixed-arrival/open-loop load or callback-streaming performance. Initial logical ACK precedes timing; an unjoined mechanical setup tail may overlap the first timed burst.

Only jointly passing unchanged3% MAD/6% central-span gates qualify comparisons. Ordinary budgets remain5% throughput loss and10% P99 increase. Every failed noise gate is preserved; no qualified conclusion follows from raw medians.
CPU/RSS, pinned repeated mixed workloads, upstream comparison, native Linux-host and>=72h acceptance remain open. WSL ASan/UBSan/leak-halt and TSan are not native-Linux production qualification.
